title: GitOps & Progressive Delivery (ArgoCD)
description: Master GitOps principles using ArgoCD and Kubernetes. Learn declarative synchronization, automated reconciliation, canary rollouts, and Git-driven deployment pipelines.
objectives: Understand Core GitOps Principles (Git as Single Source of Truth)
Understand Push-based vs Pull-based deployment models
Execute automated canary rollouts using Argo Rollouts
